_about: Gate-eval fixtures: one baseline MIP per golden example, plus the owner context and the expected gate decisions. 'expected' is the primary answer from the golden example; 'acceptable' lists answers that are also defensible under the gate prompts' rules. Fixtures 1, 2 and 8 are SEEDS authored for this eval: the golden examples were written as new MIPs (generation mode), so their gate inputs are plain pre-transformation versions; fixture 8 re-targets the catalogue's 'School Exposure Visit' pattern to Class 8->9, because the catalogue has no such MIP. Baselines 3-7 follow the 'Baseline MIP' tables in evals/golden/*.md (paraphrased from the sources). The evidence_based gate (Tier 1 practices, frameworks/evidence-based-practices.md) was added later; its expected answers are this project's judgement and more of them allow two answers, because the plan-to-routine rule is new.

fixtures.context: The SMC has approved a discretionary fund of Rs 20,000 for this term for improving a shared school space. It is not earmarked.

mip.title: Improving a shared school space with the student cabinet
mip.objective: Improve one shared space in the school that students use every day

tasks.name: Brief the student cabinet on the shared-space improvement and the available fund
Cabinet members list problems they see in shared spaces (playground, corridors, library corner, toilets area)
HM collects price quotes for the possible improvements
HM decides which improvements to fund within the SMC-approved amount
Procure items and complete the improvements
Cabinet sets up a rota to look after the improved space

mip.title: Drafting the School Development Plan
